description: Calculate the price of a car rental from an explicit configuration: pickup place, exact pickup and return moments with offsets, timezone, and car group. A calculation only, not a reservation: no car is held or guaranteed and availability is NOT checked. The figure is an estimate for the chosen car group (a category, not a specific vehicle) and is not a comparison of what is available. Conditions you omit take stated defaults, listed under "assumptions".

car.description: Car group (a category, not a specific vehicle).

dailyMileageKm.description: Daily mileage in km; 900 is unlimited. Optional; default 150.

depositUsd.description: Security deposit in USD. Optional; default 1000.

driverAge.description: Driver age bracket: 25 means 25+. Optional; default 25.

location.description: Pickup place: exactly one of areaSlug (a Carol place, e.g. "kyiv") or custom (coordinates).

payment.description: Payment method at pickup. Optional; default "any".

pickup.description: Exact pickup moment with a required offset, to the minute: 2026-12-03T12:00:00+02:00 or 2026-12-03T10:00:00Z. Must be in the future and within 12 months (judged by dates in timeZone).

receiving.description: How the car is handed over. Optional; default "any".

return.description: Exact return moment, same format, after the pickup.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone used only to show local times, to judge "today" and the 12-month limit, and to label the link. It is not checked against the pickup place and does not change the price: the pickup and return instants above are what is priced. Use the pickup place's zone.

name: quote_rental
title: Calculate a car-rental price
